He has done over millions of deals and shipments, made a thousand treaties with rivals, and killed men who tried to expose his dirty work, Ended bloodlines with a snap of a finger. he was at the top of the underground empire he built from the bottom up when he was just 15, Even the government and police are afraid of taking this guy down. That was his ***Final Straw***.*
